answer: Because the onyx register is reconciled against the lotus funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the vault audit publishes the forfeited amount. Disclosure is cheap for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which pays 9 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 9 epochs. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
